mapper.select: select null id,u.user_id,null member_no,null position,null biz_line,null role_type,null leader_id,null primary_responsibilities,null backup_responsibilities, null join_date,null member_status,null version,'0' del_flag,null create_by,null create_time,null update_by,null update_time,null remark, u.user_name,u.nick_name,null leader_name from sys_user u left join lab_member m on m.user_id=u.user_id and m.del_flag='0' where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and m.id is null order by u.nick_name,u.user_id

select null id,u.user_id,null member_no,null position,null biz_line,null role_type,null leader_id,null primary_responsibilities,null backup_responsibilities, null join_date,null member_status,null version,'0' del_flag,null create_by,null create_time,null update_by,null update_time,null remark, u.user_name,u.nick_name,null leader_name from sys_user u where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' for update

select from lab_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.del_flag='0' left join lab_member leader on leader.id=m.leader_id and leader.del_flag='0' left join sys_user lu on lu.user_id=leader.user_id and lu.del_flag='0' where m.id=#{id} and m.del_flag='0'
select m.*,null user_name,null nick_name,null leader_name from lab_member m where m.id=#{id} and m.del_flag='0' for update

select from lab_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.del_flag='0' left join lab_member leader on leader.id=m.leader_id and leader.del_flag='0' left join sys_user lu on lu.user_id=leader.user_id and lu.del_flag='0' where m.user_id=#{userId} and m.del_flag='0'
select m.*,null user_name,null nick_name,null leader_name from lab_member m where m.del_flag='0' and m.id in #{id} order by m.id for update
mapper.update: update lab_member set member_no=#{memberNo},position=#{position},biz_line=#{bizLine},role_type=#{roleType},leader_id=#{leaderId}, primary_responsibilities=#{primaryResponsibilities},backup_responsibilities=#{backupResponsibilities},join_date=#{joinDate},remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
update lab_member set member_status='INACTIVE',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
update lab_member set member_status='ACTIVE',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select from lab_skill s where s.id=#{id} and s.del_flag='0'
select from lab_skill s where s.id=#{id} and s.del_flag='0' for update
select from lab_skill s where s.skill_name=#{skillName} and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.del_flag='0' and s.id<>#{excludeId} limit 1
select from lab_skill s where s.del_flag='0' and s.id in #{id} order by s.id for update
mapper.update: update lab_skill set skill_code=#{skillCode},skill_name=#{skillName},skill_category=#{skillCategory},skill_desc=#{skillDesc},status=#{status}, remark=#{remark},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select ms.id,ms.member_id,ms.skill_id,ms.skill_level,ms.last_verified_date,ms.evidence_url,ms.version,ms.del_flag, ms.create_by,ms.create_time,ms.update_by,ms.update_time,ms.remark,s.skill_code,s.skill_name,s.skill_category from lab_member_skill ms join lab_skill s on s.id=ms.skill_id and s.del_flag='0' where ms.member_id=#{memberId} and ms.del_flag='0' and s.status='ACTIVE' order by s.skill_category,s.skill_name,s.id

select ms.id,ms.member_id,ms.skill_id,ms.skill_level,ms.last_verified_date,ms.evidence_url,ms.version,ms.del_flag, ms.create_by,ms.create_time,ms.update_by,ms.update_time,ms.remark,s.skill_code,s.skill_name,s.skill_category from lab_member_skill ms join lab_skill s on s.id=ms.skill_id where ms.member_id=#{memberId} and ms.del_flag='0' order by ms.skill_id for update
mapper.update: update lab_member_skill set skill_level=#{level},last_verified_date=#{lastVerifiedDate},evidence_url=#{evidenceUrl},remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId} and skill_id=#{skillId} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
update lab_member_skill set del_flag='2',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select id,title,period,task_level,workflow_status,result_status,plan_date,owner_id,biz_line from lab_task where owner_id=#{memberId} and del_flag='0' order by coalesce(actual_finish_time,create_time) desc,id desc limit #{limit}
